title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-08-30
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
source: Master Soundboard Reel > Cass > DAT > CD; via Seth Kaplan; Seeded to etree by Steve Barbella - Patched and Tagged by Kevin Tobin

ai_review.summary: Fantastic soundboard capture featuring a stellar Dark Star and superb Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as an awesome, crystal‑clear soundboard source that showcases the entire concert in top form. Highlights include an expansive Dark Star and a powerful rendition of Morning Dew, with the reviewer calling the whole show amazing. No technical flaws are noted, making it a highly enjoyable listen.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed 5‑star review emphasizes both an excellent performance and superb soundboard quality; the rating reflects a near‑perfect show with outstanding recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the audio as awesome and clear, with no mention of dropouts or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall flow described as consistently amazing throughout the concert.
